2610.05945.title: OntoInk: Interactive Ontology Visualization, Validation, and Reasoning
2610.05945.paper_summary: Ontology documentation, visualization, and validation are usually carried out with separate tools. This split workflow slows down development and makes knowledge transfer harder. We present OntoInk, an open-source MkDocs plugin that brings these activities together. Within a single documentation-as-code pipeline, OntoInk renders interactive ontology diagrams, validates instance data against SHACL shapes, runs OWL\,DL reasoning, and supports inline Turtle editing. General-purpose diagram plugins for MkDocs cannot parse RDF, dereference IRIs, overlay SHACL constraints, or run OWL reasoning. Compared with standalone ontology visualization tools, OntoInk embeds interactive and editable diagrams directly into documentation pages. A live demo and source code are available at \url{https://ise-fizkarlsruhe.github.io/ontoink/}.
2610.05945.paper_summary_zh: 本體文檔、可視化和驗證通常是使用不同的工具進行的。這種分散的工作流程減緩了開發進度，並使知識轉移變得更加困難。我們提出了 OntoInk，一個開源的 MkDocs 插件，將這些活動整合在一起。在單一的文檔即代碼管道中，OntoInk 渲染互動式本體圖，根據 SHACL 形狀驗證實例數據，運行 OWL\,DL 推理，並支持內聯 Turtle 編輯。通用的 MkDocs 圖表插件無法解析 RDF、解引用 IRI、疊加 SHACL 約束或運行 OWL 推理。與獨立的本體可視化工具相比，OntoInk 將互動式和可編輯的圖表直接嵌入到文檔頁面中。現場演示和源代碼可在 \url{https://ise-fizkarlsruhe.github.io/ontoink/} 獲得。
